$comment: No $id on purpose: Test-Json resolves relative references only without an absolute $id, and every Rulebook schema follows the same rule. Closed on purpose: a work package that needs a new key adds it here in its own pull request.
title: Rulebook settings
description: .github/Rulebook-Settings.json of an organization rulebook repository. Not expressible here and checked by C5: slugs unique per array after lowercasing, basedOn resolving to an existing base/<slug>.ruleset.json without a cycle, quarantine values naming stages from the settings. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md section 8 and docs/reference/naming.md.

slug.description: A level or stage slug: the lowercased name.

name.description: A level or stage name. Lowercased it is the slug, so only letters, digits and hyphens: no spaces, no dots.

quarantinePolicy.description: null (the template ships null on purpose and the scan refuses to run, D14) or the stage slugs that receive new ids.

basedOn.description: The name of the level file this level is a delta on, matched case-insensitively; absent for a root level (D29).

templateUrl.description: The template the update workflow pulls from, AL-Go style: https://github.com/ALCops/rulebook@main.

templateSha.description: The template commit installed last; empty until the first update.

baseUrl.description: Where rulesets/ is served from: https, a host name with an optional port and no user info, no query, fragment, dot segment, quote, backslash, control character or trailing slash; empty until the organization sets it (the template ships it empty and Publish fails until it is set).

publish.description: The publish target and its fields. Fields of another target are not forbidden; they are ignored.

twins.description: Which side of the twin pairs runs (D23).

quarantine.description: The quarantine policy (D14): both keys are mandatory.

levels.description: The published levels in presentation order (D26).

stages.description: The stages in presentation order; default is mandatory (D26).

ghTokenWorkflowSecretName.description: Name of the write token secret (O4).

unusedRulebookFiles.description: Shipped level and stage files the update must not re-add (WP07).
